semantic_verification.approach: Determinism tests + boundary tests + provenance tests

actions: Type checker (mypy) on every file save

structural_violations.detection: Immediate - fail fast at analysis time

semantic_violations.recovery: None - semantic violations indicate implementation defect
semantic_violations.consumer_impact: No impact (caught in testing before release)

error_reporting.format: Structured error with full diagnostic context
error_reporting.logging: Error logged with full trace for debugging

on_violation_discovery: Classify as defect or specification gap
If specification gap: update engineering evidence and contract

version_impact.structural_fix: PATCH if no behavior change, MAJOR if behavior change
version_impact.semantic_fix: PATCH if clarification, MAJOR if meaning change
